description.7.0: Sample pile responses. Quantities for sampling include force and moment acting on the pile itself, and displacement, stress, and yield state in both the normal and shear coupling springs.
description.9.0: ELEMENT SPEC REQUIRED: after the quantity keyword, the target must be identified with 'component-id <i>' or 'position <v>' — otherwise the engine rejects with 'Must specify an element, by component-id or position.' Verified live against FLAC3D 9.7 (beam and shell families; both forms created histories).

notes: '[pilehistoryblock]' at the end of a keyword's syntax is not a literal token: it marks where this command's shared modifier keywords may follow (component-id, end, position, name).

keywords.name: coupling-displacement-normal
keywords.description: displacement in the normal direction coupling spring at end of the element. Sign convention for normal spring is+/-, indicating separation/overlap.

keywords.name: coupling-stress-normal
keywords.description: stress in the normal direction coupling spring at end of the element. Sign convention for normal spring is +/-, indicating separation/ overlap.

keywords.name: coupling-yield-normal
keywords.description: yield state in the normal direction coupling spring at end of the element. Value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, yielding now, or yielded in past, respectively.

keywords.name: coupling-displacement-shear
keywords.description: displacement in the shear direction coupling spring at end of the element. Sign convention for shear spring is +/- with respect to average axial direction of pile.

keywords.name: coupling-stress-shear
keywords.description: stress in the shear direction coupling spring at end of the element. Sign convention for shear spring is +/- with respect to average axial direction of pile.

keywords.name: coupling-yield-shear
keywords.description: yield state in the shear coupling spring at end of the element. Value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, yielding now, or yielded in past, respectively.

keywords.name: ipstress
keywords.description: axial stress ( \(\sigma_{xx}\) ) for an element with a plastic material model. Uses the integration-point keyword.

keywords.name: component-id
keywords.description: the particular element is identified by the CID number. If this keyword is used, position should not be used.

description.7.0: the quantity will be sampled at end i (where i is 1 or 2), which corresponds with the order in the nodal-connectivity list. The history is sampled at end 1 (the default) if this keyword is not supplied.
description.9.0: the quantity will be sampled at end i (where i is 1 or 2 ), which corresponds with the order in the nodal-connectivity list. The history is sampled at end 1 (the default) if this keyword is not supplied.

keywords.name: integration-point
keywords.description: the integration point at which the axial stress is sampled. Integration-point locations follow the plastic-integration layout configured with 'structure <type> cmodel plastic-integration' (cross-section layout and along-length count); the layout figures are on the official Structural Elements formulation pages (the original hyperlink targets, lost in extraction). If this keyword is not specified, then the integration point index is set to 1 . Only available if noted.

description.7.0: the particular element is identified by (v) coordinates (the nearest element is taken). If this keyword is used, component-id should not be used.
description.9.0: the particular element is identified by ( v ) coordinates (the nearest element is taken). If this keyword is used, component-id should not be used.
